title: Prospective multicenter validation of a CNN-based TW3 bone age system
summary: A convolutional neural network TW3 bone age system built on 9,059 radiographs was validated prospectively on 744 hand radiographs (ages 1-20) from nine children's hospitals, against experienced reviewers. It achieved RMSE 0.52 years and 94.55% accuracy within one year for radius, ulna and short bones, and RMSE 0.85 years and 80.38% for the carpal series, with substantial agreement by Kappa and Bland-Altman analysis. Accuracy was weaker under age 7 for some series, and the reference standard is reviewer readings. Only the abstract was reviewed.
ai_technology: Convolutional neural network TW3 bone age assessment system for hand radiographs
organization: Children's Hospital of Zhejiang University; Zhejiang University
